question: Should ClawHub change from the fixed MIT-0 skill-license contract to supporting stored MIT for declared package.json or LICENSE metadata, including existing-version backfill?
rationale: Current main and prior maintainer discussion encode fixed MIT-0, while this PR changes the public license contract and production data behavior.

options.title: Confirm mixed MIT support
options.body: Approve the MIT/MIT-0 model, require real behavior proof, and require an operator-safe production backfill/runbook before merge.

options.title: Limit to future versions
options.body: If existing data should not be rewritten yet, narrow this PR to new publish/import behavior and track production repair separately.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: If the March product direction still stands, close or pause this PR rather than merging a conflicting license model.

recommendation.title: Confirm mixed MIT support
